title: C7 spec-review verdict
description: Fresh-context judgment of a node's C1 spec BEFORE any building (spec §2.1 step 2). The judge decides whether the spec is coherent, faithful to the issue intent, and not over/under-scoped. A 'fail' halts the node; 'revise' triggers one bounded re-spec retry; 'pass' proceeds to plan.

verdict.description: pass = spec is sound, proceed to plan. revise = fixable issues, re-spec once. fail = the spec is unsound and the node halts.

issues.description: Specific problems with the spec. Required when verdict is revise/fail; may be empty on pass.

severity.description: blocker = spec cannot be built against as-is; warning = should be addressed; info = observation.

description.description: One or two sentences describing the spec problem and what a sound spec would say instead.
